methods_text: Six databases (PubMed, PsycINFO, Scopus, Ovid MEDLINE, SPORTDiscus and EMBASE) searched from inception to 27 June 2023; strategy modified per database (e.g. MeSH where possible); where possible limited by language (English), species (human) and type (journal); reference lists of included studies checked.
